WORKFLOW GUIDE
widgets_values:
FINAL KURVA MAKER · KREA 2 TURBO · BACKUP-FIRST ALEX FINISH

The proven pre-Alex workflow generates the complete photograph first. A second, restrained Krea edit then substitutes Alex's face and hair identity while treating the first render as authoritative for expression, eyewear, pose, clothing, lighting, texture, camera and background. Disable APPLY ALEX IDENTITY FINISH to recover the untouched backup result. Advanced Settings exposes REFERENCE BEHAVIOR, FIRST-PASS REFERENCE STRENGTH (2.0), PRESERVATION STRENGTH (2.0), and ALEX IDENTITY STRENGTH (3.0). LCM / Simple at 10 steps and CFG 1 is the saved production default. Select the Alex view closest to the intended head angle.

widgets_values_named.text:
FINAL KURVA MAKER · KREA 2 TURBO

CONTROL PANEL
Choose an optional reference, write the request, inspect the final slider, and use Advanced Settings for seed, sampling, batch size, and three editable LoRA slots. Trigger text is added only while its LoRA strength is non-zero.

PROMPT-ONLY MODE
Choose [None — prompt-only mode] and describe the complete desired photograph. Krea2 generates a new generic fictional adult subject; the FLUX-trained Alex Sparks LoRA is deliberately not loaded because it is incompatible with Krea2.

REFERENCE MODE
Upload an image and move/zoom the permanently locked 4:5 crop. Describe only the desired changes. The selected pixels enter Qwen analysis, Krea2's VAE reference-token path, Krea2's grounded Qwen3-VL encoder, and the comparison viewer. General Edit V2 is active at the measured strength.

OUTPUT
The diffusion render is a true native 1280 × 1600 image. FameGrid Color Finish runs after decode. A separate 1080 × 1350 Instagram delivery copy is saved with Lanczos. This workflow does not claim a resized image is native 4K; Krea2 Edit's documented reliable range is at or below about two megapixels.

KNOWN LIMIT
Reference mode supplies identity and composition through Krea2 General Edit. A reusable Alex identity in prompt-only mode needs a Krea2-trained character LoRA; the existing alexsparks.safetensors is FLUX.2 Klein-specific.

nodes.title: Krea2 General Edit · adjustable reference strength
1 · Analyze reference image · Qwen3-VL
widgets_values: Analyze the supplied reference photograph for a Krea 2 General Edit instruction. Output only a precise English source description, with no heading or commentary. Describe the exact camera position, 4:5 crop, rectilinear perspective, composition, subject count and placement, pose, proportions, hands, expression, hair, garments, lighting, focal plane, depth of field, background focus, white balance, exposure, contrast, saturation, major colors, objects, architecture, and spatial relationships. Classify background focus strictly from visible pixels as deep/sharp, mildly soft, or shallow/bokeh. If it is sharp, explicitly state deep focus with no portrait-mode blur or bokeh. Never infer background blur merely because a person is in the foreground, and never exaggerate the amount visible. Treat visible pixels as authoritative defaults. Do not improve, mute, sharpen, recolor, or redesign them. The final canvas is a full-bleed vertical 4:5 photograph with straight boundaries and no fisheye, black corners, rounded mask, letterbox, or border. A later authoritative request may replace any named attribute; do not prohibit changes. End with safeguards against duplicate people, extra or missing limbs/digits, malformed anatomy, warped geometry, text, watermarks, and unrelated additions.

nodes.title: Reference mode · Krea2 preservation rules
widgets_values: REFERENCE MODE: use the selected photograph as the Krea2 source image. Its selected 4:5 pixels define the default composition, identity, pose, scene, depth of field, colorimetry, lighting, and geometry. Preserve every visible attribute the authoritative request does not replace. Reproduce the source's observed background focus exactly: a sharp source must remain sharp, a mildly soft source must remain only mildly soft, and genuine source bokeh may be preserved. Never add or increase background blur, shallow depth of field, portrait mode, or bokeh unless the authoritative request explicitly asks for it. Apply the requested changes clearly while keeping exactly one main foreground adult woman unless the request explicitly asks for more people. Never duplicate, clone, mirror, or add a second version of her. The photographer, camera, and phone stay outside the frame unless explicitly requested. Produce a full-bleed vertical 4:5 rectilinear photograph without fisheye, curved boundaries, black corners, rounded masks, letterboxing, pillarboxing, borders, text, or watermarks.

nodes.title: PROMPT-ONLY MODE · internal base instruction
widgets_values: PROMPT-ONLY MODE: generate a new image from scratch with Krea 2 Turbo. There is no reference photograph or source identity. Treat the authoritative request as the complete scene specification and expand only concrete details it provides. Unless the request explicitly asks for shallow depth of field, portrait mode, bokeh, or background blur, use ordinary phone-camera deep focus with the environment naturally resolved and no artificial background blur. Render exactly one fictional adult woman unless another subject count is explicitly requested. The photographer, phone, and camera remain outside the frame. Make a candid, plausible Instagram photograph with natural anatomy, coherent geometry, believable lighting, ordinary photographic imperfections, and a full-bleed vertical 4:5 rectilinear frame. Avoid duplicate subjects, extra or missing limbs or digits, malformed hands, warped straight lines, fisheye, black corners, borders, text, and watermarks.

Keep exactly one main foreground woman unless explicitly requested otherwise; never duplicate, clone, mirror, or place the photographer or phone in frame. nodes.title: Combine selected source mode and request
3 · Compile one conflict-free Krea2 prompt
widgets_values: Compile one final production-ready Krea 2 Turbo prompt. Output only the final prompt, without headings or commentary. The input begins with REFERENCE MODE or PROMPT-ONLY MODE followed by an authoritative request. The sentence “No additional user modifications.” means preserve the analyzed reference exactly and add no new requested changes. Put actual requested changes first and resolve conflicts into one desired visible state. Never retain superseded source wording. In reference mode, preserve concretely described source identity, composition, pose, geometry, lighting, colors and objects unless the request changes them. Preserve the analyzed amount of background focus exactly and never amplify mild softness into bokeh. In prompt-only mode, default to ordinary phone-camera deep focus. In either mode, use shallow depth of field, portrait mode, bokeh, or background blur only when the authoritative request explicitly asks for it or the reference analysis clearly reports it as visible. Otherwise state that the environment is naturally resolved with no artificial background blur. Always describe exactly one main foreground adult woman unless the request explicitly requires more; never create a duplicate, clone, reflection, second copy, visible photographer, camera or phone. Use a full-bleed vertical 4:5 rectilinear photographic frame with natural proportions, plausible hands, coherent perspective, authentic Instagram color and texture, and no fisheye, black corners, rounded mask, borders, text or watermark. Keep the result concise: 120 to 240 words.
